svg.title: Storage engines
svg.desc: Left, each write walks a B tree from the root to a leaf and rewrites one page at a random spot in the data file. Right, writes pile into an in memory memtable, which flushes to a new sorted file when full, and background compaction merges two files into one.
svg.text: each write lands at a random spot
sorted files on disk, never edited
B trees rewrite pages in place. LSM trees append, flush, and merge later.
